title: Animal reproduction
objective: Let animals reproduce sexually: two parents, crossed and mutated DNA, real costs.
acceptance_criteria: Offspring need two different living animals of the same kind that are close to each other, mature, have enough energy and are genetically compatible. An animal never mates with itself.
The offspring genome is a crossover of both parents plus mutation; both parent IDs and the generation are recorded.
After reproducing, a parent cannot reproduce again for a waiting time (cooldown or gestation).
The fertility trait influences the chance or the number of offspring.
Test: a single animal on its own never produces offspring.
decisions: Gestation or immediate birth; litter size.
